annotations.rationale: This names the specific disorder under study, not a broad family of diseases.
This refers to the classic form of phenylketonuria, which is a single defined disease entity/subtype.
This denotes a broad category of diseases defined by inheritance pattern rather than one uniquely defined disorder.

This is a deficiency-expression headed by "deficiency" with a specific molecular entity complement, and it appears in a causation frame for a clinical condition, so it is annotated as SpecificDisease.
PKU is the standard abbreviation for phenylketonuria and refers to the same specific disorder.
Although plural, this is a deficiency-expression involving the specific molecular entity PAH and is used in a disease-denoting context; the guideline directs such phrases to SpecificDisease.
